page_notes.crib: The Crib is an ESPN NFL 2K5 feature and not an NFL Street concept, so this page stays empty here on purpose.
page_notes.gameplay: The boot executable is SLUS_214.82, 4,623,328 bytes, sha256 88fd274...39aedfa, PCSX2 CRC E31B62CC. No patch site on it has been located by this project, and every site is per-title research. So this page carries no lane rather than a scaffold with nothing behind it -- a pnach writer with an empty translation table would be a control that can only refuse.
page_notes.saves: NFL Street 3 writes its progress to a PlayStation 2 memory card and there is no save artefact on the disc for this page to read. /DATA/STREAMED.DB is a bare EA TDB of 26 presentation tables and 361 fields, not a save [M]. Nothing has been captured from a memory card for SLUS-21482 in this project, so this page carries no lane rather than one that could only refuse.
